product.title: Explore Los Cabos City Tour, Glass-Bottom Boat Ride, Lunch and Shopping!

description.text: In Cabo San Lucas, this guided day pairs a glass-bottom boat to the Arch with a narrated city circuit, a blown-glass workshop, and a sit-down lunch window. Hotel pickup keeps the group on the published marina and downtown stops rather than a self-drive shopping loop. The boat segment is the scenic core; the land stops cover artisan and plaza time listed on the product page. The format suits visitors who want a longer guided sightseeing day without booking the Arch boat and a city van separately. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cabo San Lucas, and the itinerary stays on the Arch, downtown Cabo San Lucas, and the glass workshop that define this combination outing rather than a Todos Santos highway day.
